dct_alternative_sm: Dispositif de sécurité linéaire du ministère des Transports (MOT)
dct_description_sm: A Linear Safety Feature is one of a number of various appliances/appurtenances that have been installed or constructed either alongside or as an integral part of the road infrastructure to reduce the severity or potential of accidents. It is a Linear feature
